2. Any spot value your hook reads is attacker-controlled.

Flash accounting settles at the end of `unlock`. Until then anyone can `take()` the PoolManager's whole balance with 0 capital:

Move price → pull liquidity → call your hook → put it all back

Don't gate on spot state.
